title: Analyst
description: A company's reported numbers straight from its SEC filings: revenue, margins, net income and EPS, quarter by quarter.
disclaimer: Numbers only, as filed with the SEC. Levelset never says whether a stock is a buy or a sell.

search.label: Ticker
search.invalid: Enter a US ticker, like TSLA or BRK.B.

empty.title: Look up a company
empty.description: Type a ticker to see its last quarters, what changed, and its latest earnings release.

secPrompt.title: SEC identity needed
secPrompt.description: SEC asks every tool that reads EDGAR for a name and an email. Add yours in Settings › Data & SEC, then come back.

notFiler.title: No SEC numbers for {{symbol}}
notFiler.description: SEC has no reported quarterly numbers for this ticker. ETFs and many foreign companies do not file XBRL facts.

badge.label: Earnings this week
badge.tooltip: This company reports (or just reported) earnings this week. Prices can jump on the report.

chart.title: Revenue and EPS by quarter
chart.aria: Bar chart of revenue by quarter with a line for diluted EPS
chart.empty: Not enough quarters to draw a chart.

table.title: Quarters
table.caption: US dollars. YoY compares with the same quarter a year earlier; margins in percentage points.
table.derivedTip: Q4 is the 10-K year minus the three 10-Qs; derived EPS is approximate.

change.quarter_summary: Quarter ending {{end}}: revenue {{revenue}} ({{revenueYoy}} vs a year earlier), net income {{netIncome}} ({{netIncomeYoy}}), diluted EPS {{eps}} ({{epsYoy}}).
change.quarter_summary_derived: Quarter ending {{end}} (derived from the 10-K): revenue {{revenue}} ({{revenueYoy}} vs a year earlier), net income {{netIncome}} ({{netIncomeYoy}}), diluted EPS {{eps}} ({{epsYoy}}).
change.gross_margin_qoq: Gross margin {{value}} ({{pts}} points vs the quarter before).
change.operating_margin_qoq: Operating margin {{value}} ({{pts}} points vs the quarter before).
change.net_margin_qoq: Net margin {{value}} ({{pts}} points vs the quarter before).
change.net_above_operating: Net income ({{netIncome}}) is above operating income ({{operatingIncome}}): it includes gains outside the business (investments, tax items). Check the 10-Q before reading it as growth.
change.revenue_qoq: Revenue {{pct}} vs the quarter before (many businesses are seasonal: compare with a year earlier first).
change.facts_stale: SEC's XBRL facts stop at {{latestEnd}}, but a {{form}} for the period ending {{period}} was filed {{filed}}. Read it directly.
change.derived_quarters: Derived quarters are the 10-K year minus the three 10-Qs; derived EPS is approximate.
